value.signature: fn verify_candidate (input : CandidateInput , causes : & impl CandidateVerifier , closure : & impl ClosureVerifier ,) -> Result < CandidateContext , PackageError >

review.body: { verify_causes (& input . causes) ? ; check_closure (& input) ? ; if ! causes . candidate_causes (& input) { return Err (PackageError :: CandidateBinding) ; } if ! closure . host_determination (& input) { return Err (PackageError :: Closure) ; } Ok (CandidateContext { input }) }
review.item_premise: Complete public declarations or candidate causes and closure assertions are retained with their exact result. Candidate and publication verifiers are distinct; immutable access never promotes a proposed context to an admitted or published state. No secret, encoding recipe or deployment authentication is introduced; observation supplies none of the verifier premises.
